role_assignment_scope_id_check.name: role_assignment_scope_id_check
role_assignment_scope_id_check.value: ("scope_type" = 'Organisation' and "scope_id" is null) or ("scope_type" <> 'Organisation' and "scope_id" is not null)

routing_rule_payload_check.name: routing_rule_payload_check
routing_rule_payload_check.value: ("kind" = 'Condition' and "expression" is not null) or ("kind" = 'Action' and "action_name" is not null)

scheduled_work_item_creates_one_check.name: scheduled_work_item_creates_one_check
scheduled_work_item_creates_one_check.value: ("creates_work_item_type" is not null) <> ("creates_request_type_id" is not null)

agent_version_budget_check.name: agent_version_budget_check
agent_version_budget_check.value: "run_budget_soft_aed" is null or "run_budget_hard_aed" is null or "run_budget_soft_aed" <= "run_budget_hard_aed"

approval_decision_reason_check.name: approval_decision_reason_check
approval_decision_reason_check.value: ("decision" <> 'Rejected') or ("reason" is not null and length(btrim("reason")) > 0)

model_provider_engine_required_check.name: model_provider_engine_required_check
model_provider_engine_required_check.value: ("kind" = 'Cloud' and "engine" is null) or ("kind" = 'Custom' and "engine" is not null)

change_set_item_shape_check.name: change_set_item_shape_check
change_set_item_shape_check.value: ("operation" <> 'Add' or "before_json" is null) and ("operation" <> 'Remove' or "after_json" is null)
